name: Kaggle public profile pages
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator (Kaggle, a Google LLC subsidiary) with published terms of use and a privacy policy and more than ten years of public track record as a data-science community (A8 criteria for trusted are met; recorded community pending the tier reviewer, the lower of the two queryable tiers). P113 FC8 overlay record: 'major profile platform'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for whether a profile exists under a handle; profile content is self-asserted, and the same handle on another site does not prove identity (P113 FC13).

profile_page.title: Public profile page https://www.kaggle.com/{handle} (P113 username_check two-sided markers)

terms.quote: Not reviewed by legal_dpo (A1 'unknown'): the terms page is rendered by JavaScript and its text was not captured from this egress on 2026-11-26.
terms.reviewer: batch p1-G05-2 (listed for the legal_dpo review queue)

profile_page.notes: One unauthenticated GET per handle (P113 FC7/FC9). The normal 404 page embeds a site-wide reCAPTCHA script: weak captcha words on a 404 never read as a block (P321). Stays out of the default pack until legal records 'open' terms with evidence (FC16), a personal_data_review exists (FC14) and the team re-calibrates it from its own egress (FC2).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G05-2 (P113 username_check / username_check_extended): hosts used only by this batch (providers_seed owners.json; kaggle.com redirects to www.kaggle.com). Hit semantics: 200 + og:type profile = profile page; 404 + the generic site og:image = no profile under that handle. Organisations live under /organizations/ and are not user pages.
